by
  intro K L _ _ _ _ _ _ Q _ σ ζ m h hζ hm
  have H : (MulSemiringAction.toAlgHom (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L) σ).IsArithFrobAt Q := h
  exact H.apply_of_pow_eq_one hζ hm
target_source: ∀ (K L : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] [Field L] [NumberField L] [Algebra K L] [IsGalois K L] (Q : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L)) [Q.IsPrime] (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (ζ : NumberField.RingOfIntegers L) (m : ℕ), (∀ x : NumberField.RingOfIntegers L, σ • x - x ^ Nat.card (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K ⧸ Q.under (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) ∈ Q) → ζ ^ m = 1 → (m : NumberField.RingOfIntegers L) ∉ Q → σ • ζ = ζ ^ Nat.card (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K ⧸ Q.under (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))
